naya.title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Naya Note
naya.summary: The Smart Brain hardening pass is focused on turning the memory architecture into an enforced operating system: deterministic derived indexes, executable CI validation, reliable test invocation, hybrid retrieval, verified CIS artifacts, and explicit evidence boundaries.
lessons: A memory constitution is not enough; the rules must be executable and enforced.
Derived indexes must be deterministic or CI cannot reliably prove repository state is clean.
Verification must remain stronger than confidence: fix validator/data problems instead of weakening the gate.
The canonical event is the source of truth; indexes are derived views and receipts are evidence of completed work.
next_best_actions: Verify the post-repair Smart Brain CI run is green.
Advance semantic retrieval toward a true vector/embedding layer and measure retrieval quality.
Automate verified Daily/Weekly/Monthly CIS compounding and feed receipts.

human.title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Shawn Note
human.summary: We are moving from a well-designed Smart Notes system to a genuinely enforced Superbrain. The brain must be organized, retrievable, verifiable, testable, and able to compound learning instead of depending on a future AI to remember the rules.
lessons: The system has to prove it works, not just describe how it should work.
Time organizes memory, meaning connects it, indexing retrieves it, and verification earns trust.
Every meaningful execution should leave the brain stronger than it was before.
next_best_actions: Confirm the CI gate is green after the hardening repairs.
Keep pushing the brain toward faster, deeper, more accurate recall and automatic compounding intelligence.
